div.head: Af El. 29
div.ab: Gif hwa fæmnan beswyce unbeweddode ⁊ hire midslæpe, forgylde heo ⁊ hæbbe hy syððan him to wife. Gif þære fæmnan fæder heo þonne syllan nelle, agife he þæt feoh æfter þam weotuman.
Gif hwa fæmnan beswice unbeweddode ⁊ hire midslæpe, forgielde hie ⁊ hæbbe hi siððan him to wife. Gif ðære fæmnan fæder hie ðonne sellan nelle, agife he ðæt feoh æfter þam weotuman.

Si duxerit quis uirginem necdum desponsatam dormieritque cum ea, dotabit eam et habebit eam uxorem. Si pater uirginis dare noluerit, reddet pecuniam iuxta modum dotis, quam uirgines accipere consueuerunt.
Gif hwa fæmnan beswice unbeweddode ⁊ hire midslæpe, forgielde hie ⁊ hæbbe hi siððan him to wife. Gif ðære fæmnan fæder hie ðonne sellan nelle, agife he ðæt feoh æfter þam weotuman.

If someone deceives a virgin not yet betrothed and sleeps with her, let him compensate her and have her as a wife. If, however, her father will not give her [to him], let him give [her money] equivalent to the bride-price.

Wenn jemand ein unverlobtes Mädchen verführt und bei ihr schläft, bezahle er sie und habe sie dann zum Weibe für sich. Wenn des Mädchens Vater sie jedoch [ihm] nicht geben will, so zahle jener [Verführer ihm Buss-]geld je nach dem Wittum.

If someone seduces an unbetrothed girl and sleeps with her, let him pay for her and then have her as a wife for himself. But if the girl’s father will not give her [to him], then let that [seducer pay him compensation-]money according to the dower.

note.label: same term (weotuma)
note.quote: weotuma is earlier used (see above, MP §12) to render pretium pudicitiae.

note.label: cf. (woman receives compensation)
note.quote: Cf. Alfred §13, the language of which suggests that the woman herself was the recipient of compensation in cases of molestation or assault.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: Cf. Alfred §21, where it is established that a betrothed woman who fornicates with someone other than her intended husband is obligated to compensate the guarantor
